items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We've just mentioned three women trumpet players. We mentioned Dyer Jones, Dottie Jones, and now Leora Henderson. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: And then somebody told me the story. She -- Russell Smithwas down -- got sick playing his show on Broadway, and Leora went down there, climbed into the pit, and took over and played the show for him. That's how good she was. I said unnhh! Now you know, you learn, you know. Man, I didn't know. I was a pretty nice boy. I said (unintelligible) (Laughs.)
You know, Herman, this reminds me. We've just mentioned three women trumpet players. We mentioned Dyer Jones, Dottie Jones, and now Leora Henderson.
